استشعرا (form X)
# اِسْتَشْعَرَا (istašʕarā) /is.taʃ.ʕa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
# اُسْتُشْعِرَا (ustušʕirā) /us.tuʃ.ʕi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
# اِسْتَشْعِرَا (istašʕirā) /is.taʃ.ʕi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
